findings.description: Wildcard record '*.risky.example.com.' found. Wildcards can silently match unintended queries and are a common source of misconfiguration or DNS hijacking risk.
MX record for 'risky.example.com.' has TTL 60s, which is below the recommended minimum of 300s. Low MX TTLs can cause mail delivery failures during DNS propagation events.
A record for 'www.risky.example.com.' has TTL 120s, which is below the recommended minimum of 300s. Short TTLs increase resolver load and may expose the zone to cache-miss amplification.
